svg.title: Original schematic of vortex onset and quantized circulation
svg.desc: Three independent circular top views, drawn only as conceptual examples. First illustrates an arrangement below vortex onset with no vortex core. Second shows one discrete vortex after a critical-onset condition. Third shows several separated vortex cores under a higher rotation condition. This is a qualitative depiction, not a universal numeric critical angular velocity, precise vortex count or actual measured phase boundary. Quantized refers to circulation, not permitted bulk speed values. Not a copy of any NBF figure.
svg.text: Rotation and quantized vortices — conceptual states
